title: Support structural JSON Schemas in imported Skill.md manifests
goal: Allow imported Skill.md files to carry actual input/output JSON Schema contracts so central SkillRuntime validation enforces declared constraints instead of treating section identifiers as unconstrained schemas.
context: SkillMarkdownParser currently maps the Input and Output sections to SchemaDocument.identifier while leaving rawJSON at its default '{}'. Runtime validation therefore has no structural constraints for imported Skills, even though direct manifests can declare JSON Schema. Add optional single-line inputSchemaJSON and outputSchemaJSON front-matter fields; preserve existing identifier sections and backward compatibility when fields are absent.
forbidden_changes: Do not reinterpret the existing Input/Output section identifiers or break existing Skill.md files.
Do not claim full JSON Schema support; runtime remains limited to the validator's explicitly supported subset.
Do not silently accept malformed JSON Schema documents.
Do not weaken Agent scope, policy, approval, cancellation, executor availability, or verification.
acceptance_criteria: SkillMarkdownParser preserves the existing Input/Output identifiers while loading optional inputSchemaJSON/outputSchemaJSON into SchemaDocument.rawJSON.
Malformed or non-object schema JSON is rejected during Skill.md parsing.
Runtime regression proves a parsed imported Skill with a structural input schema rejects invalid input before executor side effects.
A parsed output schema is carried into executeVerified so output contract validation is enforceable.
Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA pass on the final PR head.
verification: Confirm Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA pass on the final PR head.
recovery: Revert the single logical change if existing Skill.md files regress; retain backward-compatible unconstrained schemas when the new front-matter fields are absent.
